summary: This clinical trial compares two different semaglutide injections in adults with type 2 diabetes whose blood sugar is not well controlled by metformin alone. Participants are given either semaglutide or Ozempic once a week as an add-on to metformin. The study is a Phase 3 trial sponsored by Chengdu Brilliant Pharmaceutical Co., Ltd. with a target enrollment of 478 participants.
